note: Portal URLs for services that can be started online. These are deliberately NOT in data/offices/*.json - those files are faithful transcriptions of published citizen's charters, and vendor URLs are neither charter content nor stable. Kinds are honest about what each link actually is: 'portal' is a working online transaction, 'guide' is a document describing a procedure you still complete in person, 'payment' is a payment channel only. Sources: legazpi.gov.ph/online-services-services and the city's Filipizen tenant.

ccr.title: Check a civil registry record by email
ccr.caveat: A charter service, not a portal: you email the request and the office replies. Collecting the document itself still means a visit.

ceo.title: Building permit online application
ceo.caveat: A PDF describing the procedure. The application itself is still completed at the City Engineer's Office.

ceo.title: Certificate of occupancy online application
ceo.caveat: A PDF describing the procedure. The application itself is still completed at the City Engineer's Office.

cto.title: Real property tax billing and payment
cto.caveat: Pays an assessed bill. The assessment itself is still made at the City Treasurer's Office.
